A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Score as Action research. Text, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable and matchable; v2 retains Appendices A–B and adds Appendix C.1.

before.justification: v1 reports original CIFAR-10 generation experiments, Stable Diffusion fine-tuning results, value-network ablations and timestep robustness tests in Table 1 and Figures 1–9.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including FID comparisons, ImageReward curves, architecture ablations and generated-image examples.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain the Gaussian score-action policy, KL-regularized objective, predictor/corrector value network and clipped policy update. Appendix C.1 documents implementation of this existing framework rather than establishing a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-10 image generation and text-to-image alignment, including the same fixed-prompt and timestep scenarios. Appendix C adds no evaluated dataset, task or domain.

E2.justification: DxMI remains the CIFAR-10 comparator in Figure 3, and DDPO remains the Stable Diffusion comparator in Figure 9. The pretrained-model comparisons and value-network configurations are also retained.

E3.justification: The CIFAR-10 experiment retains ten generation steps and FID evaluation. Stable Diffusion experiments retain ImageReward, 25/50/100-step evaluations and the 50-step method comparison; no stated experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: The architecture ablations in Figure 2/Table 1, timestep robustness tests in Figures 1 and 7, and qualitative comparisons in Figures 4, 5 and 8 are unchanged. The new appendix contains no additional analysis.

E5.justification: The mean FID curves and shaded bands in Figure 3 are unchanged. v2 adds no experimental run counts, seeds, uncertainty definitions or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 retains all five MSE values: 2.63, 2.51, 0.67, 0.66 and 0.29. The plotted curves, generated samples and reported findings also match, with no added or removed result entries.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, theorems and derivations in Sections 2–4 and Appendices A–B are unchanged. Renaming the finite-difference scaling parameter from sigma to eta and updating a citation do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract and introductory contributions retain the same claims about solver-compatible continuous-time RL, structured value networks and policy optimization theory. The conclusion retains the claims of improved generation quality and architectural versatility.

C2.justification: Both retain the discretization-error explanation, the qualification about exchanging reward and conditional expectation, and the difficulties of PDE/temporal-difference value learning. The removed Impact Statement contains only generic societal-impact wording, not a specific limitation.

D1.justification: New Appendix C.1 specifies the sequence of trajectory collection, return computation, value fitting, Gaussian pseudo-action sampling, finite-difference advantage estimation and minibatch PPO updates. This adds implementation documentation and symbolic algorithm inputs; existing numerical settings and model-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 1.1 changes the description of Gao et al. from diffusion-model pretraining to score inference, explicitly distinguishing it from pretrained-model fine-tuning. Section 6 shifts attribution from prior fine-tuning work to diffusion-model design. The cited-work set is unchanged; Jia and Zhou's publication update is bibliographic.

P1.justification: v2 adds Appendix C.1 and its cross-reference, makes limited wording and notation edits, updates acknowledgements and removes the generic Impact Statement. The main narrative and section organization remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds the Algorithm 1 display and rearranges existing figures and surrounding text, notably moving Figure 3 from the lower left to the upper right of page 7. Table 1 and all nine figures retain their content.

improvement.justification: Appendix C.1 makes the existing procedure easier to inspect and implement by collecting sampling, value fitting, advantage estimation and policy updates into explicit pseudocode. The distinction from Gao et al. also becomes clearer. These are limited documentation gains: experimental evidence and proofs are unchanged, and several algorithm inputs remain symbolic.
